title: Show customer info and address on dispatcher job cards
tech: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, CSS Modules, Axios
keyConstraints: TypeScript strict mode, no UI component libraries, CSS Modules only, no inline styles
description: Update JobCard and SortableJobCard to show full pickup address and customer name below the title. The card should display street on one line, postal code + city + customer name on the second line. Also add customerName and customerPhone input fields to JobEditModal so dispatchers can set them when creating or editing a job.
acceptanceCriteria: JobCard and SortableJobCard show street (line 1), postalCode + city + customerName (line 2) below the title row
Address lines are only rendered when the field has a value — no empty lines for missing fields
JobEditModal has customerName (text input) and customerPhone (text input) fields, optional
JobEditModal submits customerName and customerPhone to PATCH /api/jobs/:id
Job and JobFormData types in DispatcherBoard/types.ts include customerName and customerPhone as optional strings
npx tsc --noEmit passes with no errors
implementationNotes: Card layout goal: '08:00–10:00  Title   DRAFT' on row 1, 'Aleksanterinkatu 15' on row 2, '00100 Helsinki  •  Yritys Oy' on row 3.
Use CSS Modules for layout — no inline styles.
Only render address rows when the relevant fields are non-empty strings.
SortableJobCard wraps JobCard — if JobCard accepts props correctly, SortableJobCard may need no logic changes beyond passing the new fields through.
In JobEditModal, add customerName and customerPhone as optional text inputs in the existing form layout.
Use axiosInstance from api/axios.ts for the PATCH call (not apiService), unless the modal already uses a different pattern — do not change the existing HTTP client pattern.
Do not rewrite working code — only add what is missing.
securityConsiderations: No special considerations — these are plain optional text fields submitted by authenticated dispatchers.
